facts.rationale: Replaces misleading animation-cycle countdown terminology with the exact guard and update cadence visible in the consumer.
facts.value: Enters Master Hand's FingerGun1 setup phase, initializes animation, seeds a randomized delay in mv.mh.unk0.x50, and clears command variables 0–2. The delay is consumed on each subsequent animation update reporting no remaining frames, rather than once per restarted animation cycle.

evidence.why: Complete entry and subsequent animation behavior.

facts.rationale: Preserves exact ordering, strict comparisons and the post-animation delay without inferring repeated setup animations.
facts.value: Unconditionally enters ftMh_MS_FingerGun1 with motion-state arguments 0, 0, 1, 0, 0, invokes ftAnim_8006EBA4, stores xE4 + HSD_Randi(xE8 - xE4) in x50, and clears command variables 0–2. FingerGun1_Anim leaves x50 unchanged while frames remain. On each update reporting no remaining frames it sets command variable 2, subtracts one from x50, and, only when the result is negative, enters FingerGun2, sets x54 to xF0 if ftLib_80087120(gobj) > xEC or to one otherwise, and clears command variable 2. It does not restart FingerGun1 between countdown updates.
